annotations.title: Search what was exchanged with payers

description: Search everything one customer exchanged with payers and public records: the status checks and what each payer said, status calls (summary and the end of the transcript), status emails and the payers' replies, applications sent by email, fax, mail or on a payer's site, the roster's public record changes, and for prior authorizations the status updates, faxes and calls. Each result has its time, institution, channel, direction (outbound, inbound or read), a one-line summary, the words, a snippet and its source row. Opened by access_token (a payer follow-up, firm or prior authorization token) or agent_key (the records of its verified owner email, with record on in connect settings); one customer's records only. q: words (all must appear; match any for a question in a sentence), "quoted words" together, an NPI matches that clinician.

access_token.description: A payer follow-up, firm or prior authorization access token.

agent_key.description: An agent key whose owner email is verified and whose connect settings have record on: searches what that email owns.

institution.description: A payer or source, as named on the records.
